headline: Divgi Torqtransfer Systems reports resignation of I Kokare
summary: Divgi Torqtransfer Systems Limited has officially notified the NSE regarding the resignation of I Kokare from their position. The resignation is effective as of October 30, 2026. No further details regarding the departure or a successor were provided in the filing.
